channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Wesley Matthews | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Wesley Matthews from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Wesley Matthews, Marc Gasol, Montrezl Harrell
item.description:
“When you have talented guys like LeBron and AD things on the offensive end are going to work themselves out. “You look at the guys we added: Schroder I think is a pit bull of a defender. Montrezl Harrell is one of the hardest-playing players in the NBA, just the way he brings it every night. I think Marc Gasol, [the 2013] defensive player of the year who is one of the highest-IQ players in today’s game, and then Wesley Matthews, who manages to stand out.”

Rob Pelinka on Wesley Matthews, Marc Gasol, Montrezl Harrell, Dec 5, 2020. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Robin Lopez on Wesley Matthews, George Hill, Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Fred Katz:Robin Lopez:

“I’m really gonna miss playing with Wesley and Giannis and Khris Middleton and PC and George and so many players, but I’m not gonna miss Brook. I can tell you that.”

Robin Lopez on Wesley Matthews, George Hill, Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nov 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Rodney Hood on Kevin Durant, DeMarcus Cousins, Wesley Matthews
item.description:
“I reach out to Kevin Durant or Wesley Matthews, DeMarcus Cousins ... the guys who have been through it, and I just get confident more and more every day.”

Rodney Hood on Kevin Durant, DeMarcus Cousins, Wesley Matthews, Jun 16, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kyle Korver, Wesley Matthews
item.description:
“And at the time, Wesley Matthews and Kyle Korver were the guys I felt like could help us win.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Kyle Korver, Wesley Matthews, Mar 4, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Thaddeus Young on Wesley Matthews
item.description:
Scott Agness:Thad Young on adding Wes Matthews:

“Perfect pickup for us.… He brings toughness and embodies what we’re about here.”

Thaddeus Young on Wesley Matthews, Feb 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Wesley Matthews
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on Wesley Matthews:

“He's doing OK. His foot's still bothering him a little bit, so we're hoping that he'll be OK tomorrow. But we're watching it very closely.”

Rick Carlisle on Wesley Matthews, Dec 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Wesley Matthews
item.description:
Dirk on Wesley Matthews:

“We feel bad for him, we think about him. But like I said, he’s a warrior. He’ll be back next season for sure.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Wesley Matthews, Mar 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Wesley Matthews
item.description:
Carlisle on Wesley Matthews:

“Our doctors said, ‘Hey, we should make 100 percent sure, take an X-ray,’ and the X-ray revealed a very small shadow and then they confirmed it yesterday on an MRI.”

Rick Carlisle on Wesley Matthews, Mar 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Terry Stotts on Wesley Matthews
item.description:
Blazers coachTerry Stotts on Wesley Matthews' popularity in PDX vs. DAL.:

“Money comes into it, expectations come into it - can’t really speak to how he’s received here. His style of play endeared him 2 the fans. He was gritty, tough-nosed - all the things you like in a player.”

Terry Stotts on Wesley Matthews, Jan 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Wesley Matthews, Yogi Ferrell
item.description:
Donnie Nelson on how someone like Ferrell doesn't catch on with a team sooner than he did with the Mavericks:

“That's a great question. We currently have seven of those guys in our locker room, three of which are starting. You got Wes Matthews that went through the same thing. J.J. Barea, as you remember. I think it's a couple things. First of all, the talent level is so significant and then the influx of international kids, sometimes kids get lost in the cracks. Then you always have the Division II or III guys or the low D-Is who don't quite hit their stride. That's the great thing obviously about the D-League is it gives these kids an opportunity to spread their wings and fly in NBA systems.”

Donnie Nelson on Wesley Matthews, Yogi Ferrell, Feb 17, 2017. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Raymond Felton, Wesley Matthews
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on opting to play Raymond Felton ($3.95 million salary) over Wesley Matthews ($16.4 million salary) in crunch time:

“I don't look at money. We're trying to win basketball games. You've got to look at the guys available and what their value is in that particular situation. It's simply a coach's decision.”

Rick Carlisle on Raymond Felton, Wesley Matthews, Mar 10, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Wesley Matthews
item.description:
Tim Cato:Rick Carlisle on Wes Matthews:

“He's fine. And I'm not going to fist fight him to try and sit out tomorrow (for rest).”

Rick Carlisle on Wesley Matthews, Jan 31, 2016. Source: Twitter @tim_cato.

item.title: Chandler Parsons on Wesley Matthews, DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Chandler Parsons on DeAndre Jordan/Wes Matthews duo:

“I couldn’t think of a better five and two that I would want to play with.”

Chandler Parsons on Wesley Matthews, DeAndre Jordan, Jul 6, 2015. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Sherrod Blakely on Wesley Matthews, LaMarcus Aldridge
item.description:
During an episode of Celtics Talk TV (below), Blakely said,

“My understanding is the Celtics are going to be open to putting together some type of package deal where they would not only bring in LaMarcus Aldridge, they'd bring in one of his good friends by the name of Wes Matthews. Now, if you're the Celtics and you can put together a deal to get those two guys in town, you've gotta do it.”

Sherrod Blakely on Wesley Matthews, LaMarcus Aldridge, May 13, 2015. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Wesley Matthews
item.description:
Aside from Aldridge, Matthews, 28, is likely to be the most-pursued of the Blazers' free agents, even as he rehabs from March surgery for a torn Achilles tendon.

“As evidenced by our 11-15 record (actually 11-16) without Wesley and a first-round playoff exit for a team we thought had chance to compete for the Western Conference title, we know how important he is,”

Neil Olshey on Wesley Matthews, May 2, 2015. Source: Portland Tribune.
